data: Microsoft delivered a strong fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 18.0% to $198.3 billion from $168.1 billion in fiscal 2021. Profitability kept pace and then some: net income grew 18.7% to $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022, up from $61.3 billion a year earlier, so earnings growth slightly outstripped the top line. Cash generation was equally robust, with operating cash flow climbing to $89.0 billion in fiscal 2022 from $76.7 billion in fiscal 2021. The balance sheet expanded as total assets reached $364.8 billion in fiscal 2022 against $333.8 billion in fiscal 2021, while total liabilities rose more modestly to $198.3 billion from $191.8 billion. Cash and cash equivalents edged down to $13.9 billion in fiscal 2022 from $14.2 billion. Overall, the fiscal 2022 results point to durable growth and strong cash conversion.
